name: argocd
title: ArgoCD
description: Search ArgoCD applications and projects, browse resources and logs, and log in via SSO
author: erecarte-twilio

commands.name: login
commands.title: Login
commands.subtitle: ArgoCD SSO
commands.description: Runs `argocd login <server> --sso` to authenticate the argocd CLI

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Optional. If set, used directly. Otherwise the token is read from the argocd CLI config file.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: argocd Config Path
preferences.description: Path to the argocd CLI config file. Defaults to ~/.config/argocd/config.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
